question: In evidence.zip, Use the unique d27-- member whose basename ends tcc.elf. Classify the debug-information format the build carries: dwarf when a .debug_info section is present, stabs when a .stab section is present, none when neither. Submit exactly one listed lowercase token.
generator_cmd: sh tc_gen.sh  # gcc -g -Wl,--hash-style=gnu | gcc -S + as --gstabs + gcc -Wl,--hash-style=sysv | gcc -Wl,--hash-style=both
oracle_cmd: sh -c 'd=$(readelf -SW gf_tc_stabs.elf | grep -c "\] \.debug_info "); s=$(readelf -SW gf_tc_stabs.elf | grep -c "\] \.stab "); [ $d -gt 0 ] && echo dwarf || { [ $s -gt 0 ] && echo stabs || echo none; }'
